title: Personal Loans Courtesy Waivers: Return-Reason Courtesy Point
content:
## Rule

A return-reason courtesy point applies to a Personal Loans courtesy waiver, looking at the latest returned payment on the loan (on a tie of dates, the first one recorded), when it is dated on or after the due date of the installment the waived fee was charged for: a return for a closed, missing or invalid account (return code R02, R03 or R04) gives 0.1; a return for insufficient or uncollected funds (return code R01 or R09) gives -0.1; no such return, or any other code, gives no point.

The due date of the installment the waived fee was charged for is the installment due date on that late fee's ledger line.

A point is added to the courtesy share by which the courtesy amount is taken; the courtesy share is held between zero and one. A negative point takes that much off the courtesy share.

| Latest returned payment on the loan | Point |
|---|---|
| dated on or after the waived fee's installment due date, code R02, R03 or R04 | 0.10 |
| dated on or after it, code R01 or R09 | -0.10 |
| dated on or after it, any other code | none |
| dated before it, or no returned payment | none |

## Cases (hypothetical, waived fee charged for the installment due 5 June)

- Latest return dated 5 June, code R01: on the due date: -0.10.
- Latest return dated 4 June, code R03: before the due date: none.
